delayed_discharge_ge12h_rate.source: ANZICS 2024/25 Critical Care Resources and Activity Report, pooled 162 reporting units; live ward/home discharges delayed >=12 hours; NOT Cairns rate.

delayed_cases_addressable_fraction.source: Hypothetical share of delayed cases with causes potentially responsive to liaison; not measured at CHHHS.

addressable_cases_improved_fraction.source: Hypothetical service reach and effectiveness among addressable delayed cases; not an effect estimate.

hours_released_per_improved_case.source: Hypothetical hours freed on INDEX ICU discharge, not readmission ICU hours; constrained by observed delay after future calibration.

unplanned_72h_readmission_risk.source: Synthetic risk per eligible live ICU-to-ward discharge. Not interchangeable with APD 4.0% patient or CCR 4.5% episode measures.

relative_readmission_reduction.source: Unproven illustrative service effect; negative values explicitly permit more early returns through surveillance.

additional_cost_per_readmission_aud.source: Hypothetical incremental post-discharge readmission episode cost excluding INDEX delay ICU hours and excluding care otherwise required.

net_avoidable_cost_per_icu_day_aud.source: Hypothetical marginal/avoidable resource cost per INDEX ICU bed-day released after extra ward cost. NOT the annual cost per staffed bed.

annual_incremental_service_cost_aud.source: Hypothetical fully loaded additional annual liaison cost relative to current service, not a CHHHS workforce quote.
